indexes.name: mercadona_products_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mercadona_products_pkey ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (id)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_is_new_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_is_new_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (is_new) WHERE is_new

indexes.name: mercadona_products_price_decreased_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_price_decreased_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (price_decreased) WHERE price_decreased

indexes.name: mercadona_products_category_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_category_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (category_id)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_name_trgm_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_name_trgm_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING gin (display_name gin_trgm_ops)

indexes.name: mercadona_health_score_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_health_score_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (health_score) WHERE (health_score IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_norm_trgm_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_norm_trgm_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING gin (display_name_norm gin_trgm_ops)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_ca_norm_trgm_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_ca_norm_trgm_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING gin (display_name_ca_norm gin_trgm_ops)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_first_seen_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_first_seen_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (first_seen_at DESC)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_price_changed_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_price_changed_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (price_changed_at DESC) WHERE (price_changed_at IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_display_name_norm_browse_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_display_name_norm_browse_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (display_name_norm, id) WHERE (published = true)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_display_name_ca_norm_browse_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_display_name_ca_norm_browse_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (display_name_ca_norm, id) WHERE (published = true)

indexes.name: mercadona_products_price_browse_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_price_browse_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING btree (unit_price, id) WHERE ((published = true) AND (unit_price IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: mercadona_products_search_fts_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_search_fts_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING gin (to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, display_name_norm)) WHERE published

indexes.name: mercadona_products_search_ca_fts_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX mercadona_products_search_ca_fts_idx ON public.mercadona_products USING gin (to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, display_name_ca_norm)) WHERE published
